title: 第13章 人傀之术
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
决赛前夜，外门管事住处。

    赵长老从演武场回来的时候，天已经黑透了。

    明天是决赛，他忙了一整天重新划分外门弟子的观赛区域，连晚饭都没顾上吃。

    身后跟着两个贴身护卫，金丹初期，是掌门配给他的外门执事。

    他推开院门，屋里没点灯。

    伸手去摸墙上的灵石灯开关，指尖还没碰到石壁，后颈汗毛忽然竖了起来——三十年的战斗本能在这一瞬间救了他半条命。

    他猛地往前一扑，一道掌风擦着后脑勺削过去，轰在对面的墙上，石壁上炸开一片裂纹。

    碎石还没落地，他已经翻身滚到院角，半跪在地上，双掌护在胸前。

    两个护卫反应极快，同时拔剑朝黑暗中刺去。

    剑光刚亮起，一道灰影从阴影中掠出。

    是陈元。

    他一掌拍在左侧护卫的剑身上，金丹巅峰的灵力直接将长剑震成两截，掌势不减，拍在护卫胸口。

    骨骼碎裂的声音在黑暗中炸响，护卫整个人倒飞出去，猛地撞在墙上，后滑落在地，嘴里涌出一股血沫，眼睛瞪得大大的，没了声息。

    右侧护卫的剑尖已经刺到陈元后颈。

    这一剑角度刁钻，剑尖上灌注了金丹初期的全部灵力，剑身嗡嗡作响。

    但剑尖在距离皮肤不到一寸的位置停住了——一只手从黑暗中伸出来，扣住了他的手腕。

    那只手很白，手指修长，指甲涂着暗紫色的蔻丹。

    唐玉不知何时出现在护卫身侧，五指像铁钳一样箍紧护卫的腕骨，指尖夹着一根细长的银针，针尖泛着墨绿色的寒光。

    银针无声无息地扎进护卫颈侧，针尖刺入皮肤的瞬间。

    护卫的眼珠子猛地瞪大，瞳孔急剧收缩。

    嘴唇以肉眼可见的速度从正常的血色变成深紫，喉咙里发出咯咯的声响。

    然后整个人软倒在地，抽搐了两下，不动了。

    赵长老没有逃。

    他知道在金丹巅峰面前跑不掉。

    他双掌齐出，灵力凝聚成两道淡金色的掌印朝陈元轰去。

    这是他压箱底的混元掌，修炼了二十年。

    掌印破空的瞬间，院中的石板上被气劲刮出一道道白痕。

    陈元没有躲。

    他抬手一爪，五指直接穿透了掌印。

    灵力在两人之间炸开，气浪将桌椅茶具全部掀飞，窗户上的糊纸被震得寸寸碎裂。

    赵长老被震得连退三步，每一步都在石板上踩出裂纹。

    还没站稳，陈元已经欺近身前一掌拍在他胸口。

    掌力触及身体的瞬间，赵长老感觉自己的护体灵力被撕成了碎片，一股冰冷的灵力透体而入，封住了他丹田里的所有灵力运转。

    赵长老闷哼一声，整个人被震得倒飞出去，后背撞在墙上，石壁上裂开一片蛛网般的细纹。

    他滑落在地，一口血咳出来，溅在石板上。

    还想起身，后脑又挨了一下，眼前一黑。

    失去意识前最后看到的画面，是唐玉从袖中取出一个暗色的小瓷瓶，拔开瓶塞，往两具尸体上倒了一种无色的粉末。

    粉末落在尸体上发出轻微的嘶嘶声，尸体接触粉末后开始冒出细小的白泡，血肉骨骼以肉眼可见的速度融化成透明液体，带着一股刺鼻的酸味，渗入石板的缝隙中。

    不到半盏茶的工夫，两个金丹初期的护卫就从这个世界上彻底消失了——连衣物、长剑、甚至是溅在墙上的血迹，都被化得干干净净。

    石板上只留下两团深色的水渍，像是谁不小心打翻了两杯茶，在月光下泛着微弱的磷光。

    赵长老的眼皮沉了下去。

    等他再次醒来的时候，发现自己被绑在一把椅子上。

    丹田里的灵力像被什么东西堵住了，完全无法调动。

    每次试图运转灵力，经脉里就传来一阵密密麻麻的刺痛，像有无数根细针在肉里同时搅动，每一下都精准地扎在经脉最敏感的位置上。

    皮肤表面又紧又痒，像是有什么东西在皮层下面蠕动，撑得皮肤快要裂开。

    “别挣扎了，老东西。你中的是念毒，越运灵力毒就越深。经脉刺痛只是开始，再撑下去皮肉会开始发紧，痒到你恨不得把自己抓烂。”唐玉的声音从身后传来，沙哑低沉，像是嗓子被什么东西熏坏了。

    赵长老咬着牙停下灵力运转，刺痛果然减轻了几分，但皮肤下面那股又紧又痒的感觉还在，像是有无数只蚂蚁在肉里爬。

    他艰难地转动脖子，眼角余光扫到一个身穿暗紫色斗篷的身影站在墙角。

    斗篷的帽檐压得很低，只露出一截尖细的下巴和涂着暗红色唇脂的嘴唇。

    她的手指从袖中伸出，指尖夹着一根细长的银针，针尖上还沾着几滴墨绿色的液体，在昏暗的灯光下泛着幽幽的寒光。

    “外门巡逻路线图在哪里。换岗时间、暗哨位置，你知道我要什么。”陈元站在赵长老面前，居高临下地看着他。

    他的语气很平，像是在问一件微不足道的小事，但赵长老从他眼底看到了一种压抑了二十年的焦渴。

    “……你要巡逻图干什么。你是戒律堂首座，外门的布防你本来就该知道。”赵长老的声音沙哑，每说一个字胸腔里都像被刀刮过。

    陈元没有回答。

    唐玉走到赵长老面前，银针在他颈侧轻轻一点。
content_en:
On the eve of the finals, the outer steward lives.
When Elder Zhao came back from the martial arts field, it was already dark.
Tomorrow was the finals. He had been busy all day re-dividing the viewing areas for the outer disciples, and he didn't even bother to eat dinner.
Behind him were two personal guards, the outer deacons assigned to him by the master in the early stage of Jindan.
He pushed open the courtyard door, but there was no light in the room.
He reached out to touch the spiritual stone light switch on the wall. Before his fingertips touched the stone wall, the hairs on the back of his neck suddenly stood up - thirty years of fighting instinct saved half of his life in this moment.
He lunged forward, and a gust of wind from his palm hit the back of his head and hit the opposite wall, causing cracks to explode on the stone wall.
Before the gravel hit the ground, he had already rolled over to the corner of the courtyard, half-kneeling on the ground, with his palms protecting his chest.
The two guards reacted very quickly, drawing their swords and stabbing into the darkness at the same time.
Just as the sword light lit up, a gray shadow swept out from the shadows.
It's Chen Yuan.
He slapped the sword of the guard on the left with his palm. The golden elixir's peak spiritual power directly shook the sword into two pieces. His palm force did not decrease and he slapped the guard's chest.
The sound of broken bones exploded in the darkness. The guard flew backwards, slammed into the wall, and then slid to the ground. A stream of blood foam poured out of his mouth, his eyes widened, and he made no sound.
The sword tip of the guard on the right had already pierced the back of Chen Yuan's neck.
The angle of this sword is tricky, and the tip of the sword is filled with all the spiritual power of the early stage of the golden elixir, and the sword body buzzes.
But the tip of the sword stopped less than an inch away from the skin - a hand stretched out from the darkness and clasped his wrist.
The hand was very white, with slender fingers, and the nails were painted with dark purple kodan.
Tang Yu didn't know when he appeared beside the guard. His five fingers tightened around the guard's wrist bones like iron pliers. He held a slender silver needle between his fingertips, and the tip of the needle glowed with a dark green cold light.
The silver needle silently pierced the side of the guard's neck, the moment the needle tip penetrated the skin.
The guard's eyes widened suddenly and his pupils shrank sharply.
The lips changed from normal blood color to deep purple at a speed visible to the naked eye, and a gurgling sound came from the throat.
Then the whole person fell to the ground softly, twitched twice, and became motionless.
Elder Zhao did not escape.
He knew he couldn't run away from the peak of Jin Dan.
He thrust out both palms, condensing his spiritual energy into two pale golden palm prints and blasted them towards Chen Yuan.
This is his Hunyuan Palm at the bottom of the box, which he has practiced for twenty years.
The moment the palm print broke through the air, white marks were scraped out on the stone slab in the courtyard.
Chen Yuan did not hide.
He raised his hand and pawed, and his five fingers directly penetrated the palm print.
The spiritual power exploded between the two of them, and the air wave blew away all the tables, chairs and tea sets, and the paper on the window was shattered inch by inch.
Elder Zhao was so shocked that he took three steps back, each step causing cracks on the stone slab.
Before he could stand still, Chen Yuan approached him and slapped him on the chest.
The moment the palm force touched his body, Elder Zhao felt that his body-protecting spiritual power was torn into pieces, and a cold spiritual power penetrated into his body, sealing all the spiritual power in his Dantian.
Elder Zhao let out a muffled groan, and was thrown backwards by the shock. His back hit the wall, and a spiderweb-like pattern cracked on the stone wall.
He slipped to the ground and coughed up a mouthful of blood, which splattered on the stone floor.
I was about to get up when I got hit on the back of my head again and my vision went dark.
The last scene he saw before losing consciousness was Tang Yu taking out a small dark porcelain bottle from his sleeve, uncorking it, and pouring a colorless powder onto the two corpses.
The powder fell on the corpse and made a slight hissing sound. After the corpse came into contact with the powder, tiny white bubbles began to appear. The flesh, flesh and bones melted into a transparent liquid at a speed visible to the naked eye, with a pungent sour smell, seeping into the gaps in the stone slabs.
In less than half a cup of tea, the two guards in the early stage of the Golden Elixir completely disappeared from this world - even their clothes, swords, and even the blood stains spattered on the wall were completely dissolved.
There were only two dark water stains left on the stone slab, as if someone had accidentally spilled two cups of tea, glowing faintly with phosphorescence in the moonlight.
Elder Zhao's eyelids sank.
When he woke up again, he found himself tied to a chair.
The spiritual power in the Dantian seemed to be blocked by something and could not be mobilized at all.
Every time he tried to use his spiritual power, he felt a dense tingling sensation in his meridians, like countless fine needles stirring simultaneously in his flesh, each stroke precisely hitting the most sensitive part of his meridians.
The surface of the skin was tight and itchy, as if something was crawling under the skin, stretching the skin to the point where it was about to burst.
"Stop struggling, old man. You are poisoned by thoughts. The more you use your spiritual power, the deeper the poison will be. The tingling in your meridians is just the beginning. If you hold on any longer, your skin will begin to tighten, and it will make you want to scratch yourself to death." Tang Yu's voice came from behind, hoarse and low, as if his throat was poisoned by something.
Elder Zhao gritted his teeth and stopped the movement of his spiritual power. The stinging pain was indeed relieved a bit, but the tight and itchy feeling under the skin was still there, as if there were countless ants crawling in the flesh.
He turned his neck with difficulty, and out of the corner of his eye he spotted a figure wearing a dark purple cloak standing in the corner.
The brim of the cloak was pushed down very low, revealing only a slender chin and lips painted with dark red lipstick.
Her fingers stretched out from her sleeves, holding a slender silver needle between her fingertips. There were a few drops of dark green liquid on the needle tip, which glowed faintly in the dim light.
"Where is the outer gate patrol route map? Guard changing time, secret sentry location, you know what I want." Chen Yuan stood in front of Elder Zhao and looked at him condescendingly.
His tone was calm, as if he was asking about a trivial matter, but Elder Zhao saw in his eyes a thirst that had been suppressed for twenty years.
"...Why do you want to patrol the map? You are the leader of the Discipline Hall, and you should know the defense of the outer door." Elder Zhao's voice was hoarse, and his chest felt like a knife was being scratched with every word he said.
Chen Yuan did not answer.
Tang Yu walked up to Elder Zhao and tapped the silver needle on the side of his neck.
title_en: Chapter 13 The Art of Human Puppetry
